distributions.used_by: The AFP half of the YXML statement export behind the v1.3.0 Isabelle shard (395 AFP sessions, 606,327 declarations): the AFP heaps were built and exported under this release, unmodified, with the AFP pin below. Its veriT needed Rosetta 2 on Apple silicon. Size and sha256 were measured on the archive the import downloaded on 2026-06-20; a HEAD request on 2026-11-15 returned the same Content-Length.

Every zproof capture (zproof_main4_v2, zproof_library_v3, zproof_afp_v4, so corpora main_v2, main_v3 and main_v32, every snapshot, slice and flip gate, and the KernelVerified shard), run on a copy with the capture-hook edit listed under not_fetched; and the stdlib half of the YXML export (476,204 declarations), run on an unmodified copy. Size and sha256 were measured on the archive in ~/isabelle-work; a HEAD request on 2026-11-15 returned the same Content-Length.

afp.used_by: The AFP half of the YXML export (with Isabelle2025, the release this AFP mirror was made for) and AFP Wave A of the zproof capture (with Isabelle2025-2, a version skew that caused the failures listed in scripts/isabelle/afp_wave_a_skip.txt). The import's checkout was a depth-1 clone of this mirror's master, which was still at this commit on 2026-11-15.

matching_release_not_used.note: Information only: this is the AFP release made for Isabelle2025-2 (its master on 2026-11-15). The import did NOT use it, and this command does not fetch it. docs/ISABELLE_REIMPORT_RUNBOOK.md section 3.6 names switching to it as the proper fix for the Wave A skew; a capture made with it would not reproduce zproof_afp_v4.

not_fetched.why: Not public. It was made by hand on 2026-07-02 in ~/Isabelle2025-2.app (outside ~/isabelle-work), the copy every zproof capture ran on, and it loaded the hook from ~/isabelle-work by absolute path. The archive carries the pristine file (sha256 7b8a7e39b87a6ebff319a4fdd3de4be4dd5c4748691b311a4616eca867ef9d79; the edited file is 6ed6d4cc4bdf33f3497234229251dd4fa2532282e0430c3e4b76f40551f4ce7b).
not_fetched.how_to_get_it: Unpack Isabelle2025-2_macos.tar.gz and run scripts/isabelle/install_capture_hook.sh on the unpacked app; the recorded diff is scripts/isabelle/patches/Isabelle2025-2-Pure-ROOT.ML.patch and the hook source is scripts/isabelle/zproof_capture_hook.ML. The hook bytes become part of Pure's sources, so any change to them means rebuilding Pure and ZP-Main (about 16 h, docs/ISABELLE_REIMPORT_RUNBOOK.md section 3.2).

not_fetched.what: The ZP-* capture heaps in ~/.isabelle/Isabelle2025-2/heaps (ZP-Main, ZP-Lib1, ZP-Lib2, ZP-Lib3a to ZP-Lib3e, and some ZP-AFP-*).
not_fetched.why: Build products of `isabelle build` on the patched app on this Mac (polyml-5.9.2, arm64_32-darwin). They are never published, and the four ISA_ZPROOF_* capture settings are frozen into them at the Pure build.
not_fetched.how_to_get_it: Rebuild. ZP-Main: copy scripts/isabelle/zp_main4_ROOT to <work>/zp_main4/ROOT, set ISA_ZPROOF_OUT=<work>/zproof_main4_v2, ISA_ZPROOF_TIMEOUT_THYS=Code_Numeral, ISA_ZPROOF_SLOW_BOX=30 and ISA_ZPROOF_BOX_TIMEOUT=60, then `isabelle build -b -d <work>/zp_main4 ZP-Main` on the patched app (runbook sections 3.2-3.3); it took 14 h 58 m and saved an 883 MB heap (docs/HANDOFF_ISABELLE_ZPROOF_2026-07-03.md). Library chain: scripts/isabelle/zp_library_v3_split_launch.sh, then zp_library_v3_lib3split_launch.sh, then zp_lib3_split2_launch.sh, or `clean mathverse isabelle-capture-chain --spec scripts/isabelle/lib3_backfill_chain.spec.json`; the successful sessions took about 29 h, and the whole run with out-of-store retries about 64 h (2026-07-14 to 07-17).

not_fetched.what: The raw per-theory zproof captures: zproof_main4_v2 (65.8 GiB, 216 .jsonl), zproof_library_v3 (27.3 GiB, 113 .jsonl), zproof_afp_v4 (144.1 GiB, 330 .jsonl, a partial AFP Wave A: 51 of 162 sessions finished) and the symlink union zproof_v31_raw.
not_fetched.why: Written by the capture hook while the heaps above were built; never published.
not_fetched.how_to_get_it: They come out of the heap builds in the previous entry: ZP-Main writes zproof_main4_v2, and the Library launchers move HOL-Library.* captures to zproof_library_v3 with --collect. AFP Wave A: `clean mathverse isabelle-sessions --mode afp --entries scripts/isabelle/afp_wave_a.txt --parent ZP-Lib3e --afp-thys <work>/afp/thys --out <work>/zp_afp_wave_a --cap 12`, then `scripts/isabelle/zp_afp_launch.sh --wave <work>/zp_afp_wave_a --parent ZP-Lib3e` (runbook section 3.6 estimates about 55 h at -j 1; the 2026-07-17 run took about 9 days to its 07-26 stall and wrote 144 GiB for 51 sessions). zproof_v31_raw: scripts/isabelle/zp_v32_finalize.sh rebuilds the union.

not_fetched.what: The assembled corpora and everything derived from them: corpora/main_v2.jsonl, main_v3.jsonl and main_v32.jsonl with their .idx sidecars, the .snap/.ckpt replay snapshots, slices, flip-gate slices, and shards/isabelle-v32.mathverse.
not_fetched.why: Derived by clean from the raw captures; regenerated, not downloaded.
not_fetched.how_to_get_it: Corpus: `clean mathverse isabelle-import --raw-dir <work>/zproof_v31_raw --corpus <work>/corpora/main_v32.jsonl --assemble-only`, then `clean mathverse isabelle-index --corpus <work>/corpora/main_v32.jsonl` (runbook section 4; pure I/O, 55.4 GB assembled in 3 min plus a 1.4 min index), or scripts/isabelle/zp_v32_finalize.sh for both. Snapshot and shard: scripts/isabelle/v32_grand2.sh, which runs `clean mathverse isabelle-import --corpus corpora/main_v32.jsonl --snapshot-out corpora/main_v32.snap --translate-budget 8000000 --workers 0 --shard-out shards/isabelle-v32.mathverse` (the last run took about 39.5 h, 2026-07-31 to 08-01, and wrote about 1-2 GB). Slices: `clean mathverse isabelle-slice`. Flip-gate slices: `clean mathverse isabelle-flip-gate --add` (pinned in data/isabelle_flip_gates.json).
